papers.title: Biofabrication, structure and characterization of an amylopectin-based cyclic glucan.
papers.abstract: A novel amylopectin-based cyclic architecture was fabricated, arising from microbial branching enzyme treated waxy rice starch. The recombinant enzyme had a molecular weight of 72.0 kDa, and exhibited optimum activity at pH 7.0 and 75 °C. During the cyclization reaction catalyzed by a branching enzyme, the molecular weight of amylopectin rapidly decreased for the initial 2 h, and then very slowly decreased, tapering off at approximately 1.8 × 105 g mol-1 at 12 h. The number of A-chain fractions greatly increased, whereas the percentage of B-chain fractions decreased after enzymatic modification, accompanied by more α-1, 6 linkage formation. The core ring structure as a glucoamylase-resistant fraction had a number-average degree of polymerization of 21, which was constructed by 19 glucose units linked with, 2 glucosyl stubs at the O-6-position of the cyclic glucan through α-1,4 and α-1,6 linkages. Similar to large-ring cyclodextrin with equal glucose units, this cyclic glucan had a cavity geometry with two-circular loops and short stubs in perpendicular planes. Moreover, this cyclic glucan could complex with iodine for the host-guest formation. These results revealed the potential application of the amylopectin-based cyclic glucan as a good delivery system to encapsulate and protect bioactive ingredients.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究支链淀粉基环状葡聚糖的制备与表征，未涉及任何AI或生物打印内容。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on enzymatic synthesis of a cyclic glucan from amylopectin for food delivery, with no AI, bioprinting, or biomedical process control.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用支链淀粉制备具有空腔结构的环状葡聚糖。
summary_zh.method: 通过微生物分支酶处理蜡质大米淀粉，经环化反应得到环状葡聚糖。
summary_zh.result: 获得的环状葡聚糖具有两个环状环和短支链，可与碘形成主客体复合物。
summary_zh.validation: 通过分子量、链长分布和酶抗性等表征验证结构。

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate a cyclic glucan with a cavity structure from amylopectin for potential bioactive delivery.
summary_en.method: Amylopectin was treated with a microbial branching enzyme to produce a cyclic glucan through cyclization.
summary_en.result: The cyclic glucan exhibited a unique geometry with two circular loops and short stubs, capable of iodine complexation.
summary_en.validation: The structure was validated by molecular weight analysis, chain length distribution, and glucoamylase resistance tests.

papers.title: Evaluation of Implants with Different Macrostructures in Type I Bone-Pre-Clinical Study in Rabbits.
papers.abstract: The objective of this study was to assess the primary stability and the osseointegration process in implants with different macrostructures (Cylindrical vs. Hybrid Conical) in rabbit tibiae. Twenty-four (24) rabbits were used, divided into 3 experimental periods (2, 4 and 8 weeks) with 8 animals each. Each animal bilaterally received 2 implants from each group in the tibial metaphysis: Cylindrical Implant (CI) and Hybrid Conical Implant (HCI). All implants were assessed for insertion torque. After the experimental periods, one of the implants in each group was submitted to the removal counter-torque test and descriptive histological analysis while the other implant was used for microtomographic and histometric analysis (%Bone-Implant Contact). HCI implants showed higher insertion torque (32.93 ± 10.61 Ncm vs. 27.99 ± 7.80 Ncm) and higher % of bone-implant contact in the 8-week period (79.08 ± 11.31% vs. 59.72 ± 11.29%) than CI implants. However, CI implants showed higher values of removal counter-torque than HCI implants in the 8-week period (91.05 ± 9.32 Ncm vs. 68.62 ± 13.70 Ncm). There were no differences between groups regarding microtomographic data. It can be concluded that HCI implants showed greater insertion torque and bone-implant contact in relation to CI implants in the period of 8 weeks when installed in cortical bone of rabbits.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及骨结合和植入物稳定性，但与髋关节假体或股骨柄的力学分析无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding or micromotion in hip implants, uses no FEA or computational modeling, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估不同宏观结构植入物在兔胫骨中的初期稳定性和骨整合效果。
summary_zh.method: 在兔胫骨植入圆柱形和混合锥形两种植入物，测量插入扭矩、取出扭矩和骨接触率。
summary_zh.result: 混合锥形植入物在8周时插入扭矩和骨接触率更高，但圆柱形植入物取出扭矩更大。
summary_zh.validation: 体内兔实验验证，包括组织学和显微CT分析。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the primary stability and osseointegration of implants with different macrostructures in a rabbit tibia model.
summary_en.method: Cylindrical and hybrid conical implants were bilaterally placed in rabbit tibiae; insertion torque, removal torque, and histomorphometric analysis were performed at 2, 4, and 8 weeks.
summary_en.result: Hybrid conical implants showed significantly higher insertion torque and bone-implant contact at 8 weeks, while cylindrical implants had higher removal torque.
summary_en.validation: In vivo animal study with 24 rabbits, including micro-CT, histological, and torque measurements.
